QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Phantasmal Crystal Ball
QuestInfo.0: Nona, a priestess of Tallahart, requests your help regarding her crystal ball.
QuestInfo.1: She explains that she needs the ancient god's power to use the crystal ball. Gather #bSoul Residue#k from Ash-Devouring Souls and Silence-Swallowing Souls.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the ancient gods' power for Nona. What will happen next?

default.0: It seems you need more Soul Residue.
